name: Furusaka Yuuya
source: Protagonist of Ouka. Lost his parents in a car accident when little, and to save his sister [url=/c6142]Yui[/url] acquired the powers of "Yui" (healing comfort) and "Magatsukaze" (calamity wind). Has just returned to the town after an absence of half a year. Misfortune seems to follow him.
translation: Protagonist of Ouka. Lost his parents in a car accident when little, and to save his sister [url=/c6142]Yui[/url] acquired the powers of "Yui" (healing comfort) and "Magatsukaze" (calamity wind). Has just returned to the town after an absence of half a year. Misfortune seems to follow him.
